field.label: Model Name
field.comment: Must be the exact model ID from your provider's API docs, not a marketing name - e.g. gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-5, claude-opus-5, gemini-1.5-flash. For "Custom / OpenAI-Compatible", use whatever model ID your endpoint expects.

field.label: Base System Prompt
field.comment: Instruct the AI about your database architecture.

group.label: Read-Only Database Connection
group.comment:
Not configurable here on purpose - the read-only DB credentials live in app/etc/env.php, not in this admin config, so they can't be viewed or changed by anyone through the admin UI (not even someone with the "AI Reports Config" permission). Changing them requires server file access, the same bar as Magento's own DB credentials.

1) Create a MySQL user with SELECT only (never the main Magento database user):
CREATE USER 'aireports_ro'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY 'a-strong-random-password';
GRANT SELECT ON your_database_name.* TO 'aireports_ro'@'%';
FLUSH PRIVILEGES;
Restrict the host part ('%') to your application server's IP where possible, and consider REVOKE SELECT on individual sensitive tables (e.g. admin_user, oauth_token, vault_payment_token) for extra defense in depth on top of the module's own guardrails below.

2) Add the following to app/etc/env.php and re-deploy (do not commit this file):
'aireports' => [
  'readonly_connection' => [
    'username' => 'aireports_ro',
    'password' => 'a-strong-random-password',
  ],
],
Until this is in place, the query tool refuses to run.

group.label: Security Guardrails
group.comment: Global only - a per-website/store-view override here could leave one scope less protected than the others without anyone noticing.

field.label: Enable Query Tool
field.comment: Master switch. Keep disabled until the read-only database user above is configured and verified.

field.label: Max Rows Per Query
field.comment: A LIMIT is automatically appended to any generated query that doesn't already have one. Default: 1000.

field.label: Query Timeout (seconds)
field.comment: Best-effort server-side execution timeout (MySQL 5.7.8+ only; ignored on MariaDB). Default: 5.

field.label: Additional Blocked Tables
field.comment: Comma-separated table names the AI is never allowed to reference, on top of a built-in, non-configurable list that already always blocks credential/token tables such as admin_user, oauth_token, api_key, vault_payment_token and core_config_data. Add any store-specific tables containing PII or secrets here, e.g. customer_entity,newsletter_subscriber
